unitsCurrencyAndSource.currency: Currency and scale are unspecified by the API. All monetary model values remain in nominal units of caller-supplied baseEarnings; never assume USD, USD million, per-share units or implicit FX.

unitsCurrencyAndSource.horizon: Year0 base and PV; stage growth years1–5; ten linear-fade years6–15; terminal growth reached in year15; first terminal distribution year16; perpetuity value at year15 discounted to year0.
unitsCurrencyAndSource.reinvestment: max(0,annualGrowth)/ROE retained fraction; terminal gT/ROE; earnings minus reinvestment distributed. No invented capital release on negative growth, implicit external funding, debt change or WC double subtraction.
unitsCurrencyAndSource.status: HTTP200 means conditional assessment computed, including mixed/all per-point refusals; body/row statuses remain distinct. HTTP400 invalid request,422 invalid economic/nonfinite result, direct handler non-GET405 with Allow GET.
unitsCurrencyAndSource.conditionality: Production/investment/identity flags remain false. Four terminal values are not probability bounds or continuous-range extrema.
